review_markdown: P11a-C1-API1 passes this narrow semantic review. The pure signed API matches every prescribed branch and input rejection rule. Native integration routes only positive charges through it, decrements the selected generation once, and preserves existing guards, effects, RNG, events and time. Public fixtures satisfy F01/F02 and API1 portions of F14; independent core literals cover F03/F04. No material findings. Full gates and root acceptance remain pending; this does not accept full C1 or close the family.
